What is a Document Portal?

A document portal is a centralized online platform where you can store, manage, and share documents with clients and colleagues. It's a secure and organized way to keep track of sensitive information, reducing the risk of data breaches and lost documents. With a document portal, you can easily access and update client records, share documents with colleagues, and collaborate on projects.

Base44 makes it easy to create a custom document portal tailored to your specific needs. You can design a user-friendly interface, add features such as document upload and download, and set up access controls to ensure that only authorized users can view and edit documents.
